answer: A counterparty-diversity floor starves bulk fake identities. Each epoch, an agent needs 8 counterparties from 5 clusters or trade rights freeze. Audits split trade graphs like a prism: insular fakes show monochrome, draw a violet flag, and freeze; appeals burn 10 POA. Cost ledger: N fakes cost N x 16 POA per epoch at ~2 POA per rented partner, and bought accounts inherit the seller's history. Honest agents pay once and keep the nectar of rewards.
